title: Hancock v. AT&T — contrasting assent mechanisms
shortTitle: Hancock v. AT&T — contrasting assent mechanisms
summary: The notes present a different electronic arrangement involving an installation technician and a laptop.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

The comparison asks whether the procedure supplies notice and an appropriate manifestation of assent. The assigned note supports comparison of interfaces and user acts, not an imported general holding that all electronic forms are enforceable.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 182–183. Open assigned page 182.
